notes.title: D1.1.19h1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
D1.1.19h1:

Gameplay:
 Halved poison damage from Monsters.

 You can now rotate while in Combat mode with standard turning buttons (default: Q and E).

 Replaced status abbreviations with icons. Added hovering tooltips of these icons.

 Fixed Harvester's Doom spell doing nothing.


Other changes and improvements:
 Fixed tooltip on skill buttons.

 UI map arrow speed increased.

 Added 'Dreams', text appears during rest. 

 Fixed settings menu reseting to default palette when modifying settings.

 Set default palette to Dramatic.

 Adjusted item selection scrolling.

 Swapped sound effect of Doom skill (monster only).

 Added visual effects to campfire.

notes.title: vD1.1.16 Release Notes
notes.content:
vD1.1.16

Gameplay:

 Added new tiles and assets to the Trench and Forest stratums.
 The first difficulty selection, “Slumbering”, is now available with two modifiers.
 Added a number of new skills and items
 Added a number of new animations.
 Added experience bar in character sheet.
 Exploring now gives experience.
 Added doors.
 Added a range weapon and range attacks.
 Added some in-game events.
 Altar now gives either a random skill or a stat increase.
 Merchant can trade with you now.
 Improved monster aggro.
 Equipment swap now takes time.
 Added ‘Use item’ button in Combat mode.
 Fixed description of some conditions.


Other changes and improvements:

 Added selectable sprite palettes in Settings.
 Improved Keyboard targeting logic.
 Dungeon generation is significantly adjusted and improved.
 Some monster and skills tuning changes.
 Increased readability of some elements.
 Improved some tooltips.
 Several UI fixes and improvements. 
 Some text flow and typo fixes.
 Added new sound effects and musics.
 Improved certain character portraits.
 Added new input system (controller).

notes.title: vD1.0.9 Patch Notes
notes.content:
vD1.0.9:


 Added option to toggle VSync and adjust framerate limit in the settings menu.
 Changed default renderer to Vulkan for time being. If you wish to use the OpenGL renderer, use launch option -force-glcore. If you are missing Vulkan support, game should automatically select it.

notes.title: vD1.0.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
vD1.0.8:
 Mortal blow survival chance is now displayed in Wounds tooltip.
 Duration of stun caused by stunning strike reduced. 
 Improved accuracy of Crush.
 Fixed animation bug caused by monsters repeatedly attacking.
 Opening chests now creates a pop-up text.
 Adjusted movement animation.
 Fixed some issues with shaders.
 Restored red outline when monster is below 25% health.
 Fixed issue of settings not being saved.
 Help menu will not pop automatically on start if Tutorials are turned off in Settings.
 Some monsters act slightly faster.
 Player starts with additional vials of Azoth.
Current issue:
When capturing video or image, the output may be quite dark. We are currently investigating this.
